profile.headline: Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments
profile.summary:
Miami University student pursuing a Computer Science Major and a Minor in Ethics from the Philosophy Department. Eager to start work on meaningful projects.

Prior experience with: 
- Agile Project Management
- Data Structures, Object Oriented Programming, Algorithms
- Creating and Manipulating Databases
- Group Management and Task boards
- Social Media Managers such as Hootsuite

Areas of Interest: 
- Frontend Web development
- Database Management
- Web Development
- Artificial Intelligence
- Ethics in Computer Science
- Esports and Esports Management

Extracurriculars: 
- D1 Varsity Esports Team Captain
- President of the Russian and Eastern European Club
- Toast Master (Public Speaking)
